title: Jones N. Forebuts and the Secret of the Golden Butt
author: Casper Candlewood

archive.primary: Jones N. Forebuts and the Secret of the Golden Butt.html

description:
A political comedy with terrible spelling.

Inspired by the 2016 election season, and sleep deprivation.

Features include butts, death, hitler, political blasphemy, diseased genitalia, and a fight to the death with the president of the United States of America.
